honest_conclusion: MotionVector primary is NULL. The raw ingredients work (structure->function p=0.019; activity->function p=2e-33), but the locomotor-reserve RESIDUAL adds no clean orthogonal signal because the accelerometry age-clock is weak (R2=0.17) with a counterintuitive age mapping in the 20-69 DXA cohort. Reported as a prespecified null, consistent with project discipline. Does NOT alter the HeartVector A-vs-D headline or the held CODE reveal.
